summary: Azenta filed an 8-K reporting an event related to a prior divestiture: its subsidiary Azenta Germany GmbH sold B Medical Systems to Thelema for $63M, with $35M deferred via a vendor loan. Thelema repaid the loan in full early ($35,373,333 including interest) on September 3, 2026, releasing the pledge. Azenta has now received the entire purchase price in cash. This is a routine post-closing collection event, not a new special situation, and does not alter terms or trigger further action. Watch for no further disclosures; the transaction is fully closed.
